value.signature: fn proposal_matches_supplied_commitment (body : & ProposalBody , recorded_proposal : & ProposalCommitment , content_pre_digest : & ContentPreDigest , author_dependency_blinding_value : & SecretSlice < u8 > , dependencies : & SecretBox < DependencyIds > ,) -> Result < () , ProfileError >

review.body: { if recorded_proposal . recipe != PROPOSAL_RECIPE { return Err (ProfileError :: Recipe) ; } let computed = proposal_commitment (body , content_pre_digest , author_dependency_blinding_value , dependencies) ? ; if computed != * recorded_proposal { return Err (ProfileError :: Proposal) ; } Ok (()) }
review.item_premise: The received hY and D remain protected; a supplied public P is compared with a recomputed public P, without authenticating an anchor.
